Full frontend E2E succeeded: filled altura_pe_direito=270 and largura_total=380, added coluna, porta, tomada, saida_gas via testids, clicked btn-salvar-tudo, POST /api/walls returned 200, navigation to /paredes occurred, new wall card visible with 1 abertura and 2 instalacoes. Export flow verified: GET /api/walls/{id}/export returns 200 with unit=mm and pontos.tomadas[{distancia_centro:500.0,lado:'direito',altura_piso:300.0}] (cm×10 correct) and pontos.saidas_gas present.
passed: POST /api/walls accepts all 6 ponto arrays (tomadas, interruptores, saidas_agua, saidas_esgoto, saidas_gas, registros_agua) without 'tipo' field -> 200 OK
PontoParede.tipo defaults to null in response
Frontend /parede/nova -> fill inputs -> add coluna/porta/tomada/saida_gas -> btn-salvar-tudo -> POST /api/walls 200 -> navigate to /paredes -> wall-card-{id} visible; success toast shown

issues: Sticky 'Salvar tudo' footer button can overlap section-toggle buttons in shorter viewports (<=900px). With force=True clicks in automation, the save button intercepts clicks meant for section-eletrica-toggle/section-hidraulica-toggle, causing accidental saves. Not a user-facing blocker (real users scroll), but consider adding bottom padding or reducing sticky footer height.

critical_code_review_comments: PontoParede.tipo is now Optional[str]=None — correct fix. Consider auto-populating 'tipo' server-side per array key (tomada/interruptor/agua/esgoto/gas/registro_agua) so the exported JSON carries semantic type per ponto for the future SketchUp plugin, instead of null.
Export endpoint drops 'tipo' from _export_ponto; if 'tipo' is meaningful downstream, include it in export payload.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo; safe today because no auth, but tighten before adding cookies/auth.
seed_data_creation: During tests, walls Parede 05..10 were created via API/UI in the shared MongoDB. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression fix for PontoParede.tipo (Optional) is verified end-to-end. Backend has 10 walls in DB from prior iterations; safe to ignore. All primary flows (create with pontos, list, export mm) pass. When automating /parede/nova with Playwright, avoid force=True on section toggles because the sticky 'Salvar tudo' footer can intercept clicks visually — use scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) then normal click.
rca of the issue: Iteration 1 failure RCA: Backend PontoParede required 'tipo: str' while frontend PontosParede factory in CriarParede.jsx never emitted 'tipo' because each category has its own array. Fix applied in iteration 2: PontoParede.tipo is Optional[str]=None with docstring explaining semantics live in the parent array key. Verified via direct curl + full Playwright E2E + export round-trip.
